Winbuzz Platform Rules and Regulations

These Rules and Regulations explain the standards users must follow when visiting Winbuzz, creating a Winbuzz ID, managing an account, communicating with support or using an available platform feature.

The purpose of these rules is to maintain lawful access, accurate account records, fair platform use, responsible behaviour and appropriate protection for users. They should be read together with the Terms and Conditions, Privacy Policy, Responsible Gaming Policy, Disclaimer, Cookie Policy and service-specific rules.

Users who do not understand a rule should contact Winbuzz before using the related feature. Continuing to use the platform after accepting the applicable rules may create a binding agreement, subject to applicable law.

General Rule of Lawful Use

Winbuzz may be used only for lawful purposes and only by users who are eligible to access the relevant service.

A feature being visible or technically accessible does not mean that it is permitted in every country, state or region. Users must check the laws applicable to their location before registering or using an account.

No user may access, advertise, promote, fund or participate in a service prohibited by applicable law.

Winbuzz may apply age, location, account-status, regulatory and technical restrictions to maintain lawful platform access.

Application of These Rules

These rules apply to public website visitors, registered account holders and any person interacting with Winbuzz support or account services.

Some features may have additional rules. These may relate to registration, verification, social games, esports, promotions, technical results, payments, responsible gaming or customer complaints.

When a specific feature has additional rules, users must read them before proceeding. The specific rules apply to that feature together with these general regulations.

If two rules appear inconsistent, Winbuzz should clarify which rule applies rather than relying on unclear or hidden conditions.

Age Requirement

Winbuzz is intended only for adults who meet the minimum legal age applicable to the available service.

A child or underage person must not create an account, use an adult’s login details or access an age-restricted feature.

Users must enter their true date of birth during registration. Providing a false date to avoid an age restriction is prohibited.

Winbuzz may request age-verification information when necessary. Access may remain limited until the required confirmation is completed.

Geographic Eligibility

Users may access only those services that are lawful and available in their current location.

A user must not hide their actual location, enter a false address, use another person’s residency details or employ technical methods to bypass a regional block.

Winbuzz may review location information, account details and technical records where reasonably necessary to manage access.

A user who moves or travels should review whether the service remains available in the new location.

Online Gaming Classification in India

Where Indian law applies, online games must be treated according to their lawful regulatory classification.

An online money game prohibited by law must not be offered, promoted, accessed or funded through Winbuzz.

Permitted esports and online social games may be subject to recognition, registration, safety and operational requirements. Their availability should not be assumed merely because they do not use a traditional casino format.

Winbuzz may remove or restrict any feature when its classification is uncertain, prohibited or awaiting regulatory confirmation.

Account Registration Rules

Every registration must be completed using accurate information belonging to the person creating the account.

A user may be asked to provide a name, date of birth, mobile number, email address, location and secure password. Additional information may be requested where a lawful account feature requires it.

Users must review their details before submitting the registration form. Incorrect information may affect account access, support, verification and permitted transactions.

Registration does not guarantee acceptance or permanent access to every feature.

One User and One Account

Unless the current account policy clearly permits otherwise, each eligible user should maintain only one personal Winbuzz account.

Duplicate accounts should not be created to bypass verification requirements, responsible gaming policies, promotional conditions, service restrictions, or a decision previously made on an account. Following the platform’s responsible gaming policy and account rules helps maintain a fair, secure, and consistent experience for all users.

A person must not create an account for a friend, family member, child or unknown third party.

If a previous registration exists, the user should recover that account or contact support instead of opening another profile.

Account Ownership

A Winbuzz account belongs to the registered user and must remain under that person’s control.

Accounts may not be sold, rented, exchanged, transferred or used as security for a debt.

Users must not allow another person to complete account activity through their Winbuzz ID.

Winbuzz may request ownership confirmation when login patterns, device records or registered details indicate that another person may be controlling the account.

Accurate Profile Information

Users must keep registered contact and profile information accurate.

An important change to a name, mobile number, email address or residence may require verification before it is accepted.

Users must not submit altered, fabricated, expired or stolen identity information.

A profile may be restricted when its details are inconsistent, misleading or connected to another person without lawful authority.

Verification Rules

Winbuzz may request information to confirm identity, age, residence, account ownership or eligibility for a lawful feature.

Users must submit documents through the secure method identified by the platform. They must not send documents to unknown messaging accounts or public social media pages.

Uploaded information should be readable, current and consistent with the account record.

Verification may remain pending when information is incomplete or requires additional review. Users should follow the displayed instructions rather than submitting repeated copies without a request.

Password Rules

Every user must create a strong and unique password.

Passwords should not contain easily guessed details such as a name, mobile number, birth date or simple sequence.

Users must not share passwords with support agents, friends, family members or third-party account managers.

A password should be changed immediately when the user believes that another person may know it.

OTP and Authentication Rules

A one-time password or verification code is private authentication information.

Users must enter an OTP only on the verified Winbuzz interface for the action they initiated.

No person should ask a user to send an OTP through a message, telephone call, public form or social media conversation.

An unexpected OTP request may indicate an attempted winbuzz login or account change. The user should avoid approving it and review account security.

Device and Session Rules

Users should access Winbuzz through trusted devices and secure network connections.

A shared or public device must not be allowed to save account credentials. The user should sign out completely after finishing.

Users should review active sessions where that option is available and remove access from devices they no longer control.

A lost device connected to the account should be reported promptly. The user should also protect the registered mobile number and email address.

Verified Website Access

Users should open Winbuzz directly or through a trusted bookmark.

Login credentials must not be entered on a website reached through an unknown message, advertisement or copied support page.

Similar branding, colours or logos do not prove that a page belongs to Winbuzz.

Suspected impersonation, copied websites or fraudulent support profiles should be reported through the verified Contact Us section.

Permitted Use

Winbuzz may be used to review public information, manage an eligible account, access lawful platform services, contact support and use available account controls.

Users must follow the instructions displayed for each feature.

A user may retain reasonable personal records relating to their account but must not reproduce protected platform content for unauthorised commercial use.

Permitted access does not include the right to interfere with the platform, another account or a service provider.

Prohibited Account Activity

Users must not provide false information, impersonate another person, misuse an account or attempt to conceal unlawful activity.

Account sharing, identity misuse, fraudulent documents and unauthorised payment methods are prohibited.

Users must not use Winbuzz to harass another person, distribute malicious content or conduct unlawful transactions.

A serious violation may result in temporary restriction, investigation, service removal or account closure, subject to applicable law.

Automated Access and Bots

Users must not use automated scripts, bots, scraping systems or similar technology to interact with protected areas without written permission.

Automated tools must not be used to create accounts, submit repeated requests, manipulate platform activity or avoid access controls.

Winbuzz may block traffic that creates an unreasonable technical burden or threatens platform security.

Security research should be conducted only through an authorised disclosure process.

Platform Security Rules

No user may attempt to test, scan, damage or exploit the platform without authorisation.

Introducing malware, collecting another user’s credentials, bypassing verification or interfering with website functions is prohibited.

Users who identify a possible security problem should report it privately and avoid publishing instructions that could place other users at risk.

Winbuzz may preserve relevant records and cooperate with authorised investigations where required.

Social Game Rules

Where a permitted online social game is available, users must follow its published participation and conduct requirements.

A social game must not be converted into an unauthorised real-money arrangement between users.

Participants must not manipulate results, collude or use prohibited assistance.

Winbuzz may review game activity when there is credible evidence of unfair conduct or technical misuse.

Esports Rules

A permitted esports event may apply eligibility, registration, equipment, conduct and result-verification requirements.

Players must use their own authorised accounts and must not receive prohibited assistance during competition.

Cheating software, match manipulation, account substitution and collusion are prohibited.

The relevant organiser’s confirmed result applies, subject to any valid complaint or appeal process.

Sports Information Rules

Sports schedules, scores, statistics and match content may be supplied by event or data providers.

Users should understand that live information may be delayed or corrected.

Historical performance and statistical analysis do not guarantee a future result.

No user may misuse sports content to claim that Winbuzz guarantees an outcome or offers inside information.

Event Changes and Cancellations

Sporting and competitive events may be postponed, abandoned, interrupted, shortened or rescheduled.

Winbuzz may update the displayed status when reliable information becomes available.

Users should review the rules applicable to the relevant informational feature, competition or permitted service.

A change to an event should not be interpreted as a platform guarantee, prediction or admission of liability.

Fair-Play Standards

Users must act honestly when using competitive or interactive features.

Collusion, impersonation, result manipulation, unauthorised software and exploitation of another user are prohibited.

Users must not intentionally take advantage of a technical error after becoming aware of it.

Winbuzz may investigate suspicious patterns before confirming a result or restoring access.

Technical Error Rules

A technical error may include an incorrect display, duplicated record, interrupted session or software malfunction.

Users who notice an error should stop using the affected feature and report it.

Winbuzz may review technical logs and provider records to determine what occurred.

An obvious error may be corrected when reliable evidence supports the correction. Error rules must not be used to change valid records arbitrarily.

Payment Rules

Payment functions may be offered only when connected to a lawful and permitted service.

Users must use payment methods they are legally authorised to control.

A user must follow the payment details displayed inside the verified account. Payment instructions received from an unknown person should not be used.

Where a fund transfer is prohibited by applicable online gaming law, it must not be initiated, accepted, facilitated or disguised.

Payment Credential Security

Winbuzz support should not require a UPI PIN, card PIN, online banking password or complete payment credential.

Users must never send these details in a support message.

Payment confirmation should rely on transaction references and authorised provider records.

Any person requesting remote device access or private payment authentication information should be treated with caution.

Pending Transactions

A pending transaction remains under processing or review and should not automatically be repeated.

Users should check the transaction status, account history and payment-provider record.

The payment reference, amount, date and time should be retained.

If the stated processing period passes, the user may contact support with accurate evidence.

Failed and Reversed Transactions

A failed payment was not completed. A reversed payment may have been deducted temporarily and then returned.

Users should confirm whether the funds have returned before submitting another request.

Edited receipts and fabricated references are prohibited.

Winbuzz may need to compare the platform record with authorised provider information before confirming the final status.

Withdrawal and Refund Rules

A lawful withdrawal or refund may be subject to account verification, accurate payment details and the rules of the permitted service.

Users should submit only one clear request and retain its reference.

An estimated processing period is not a guarantee unless expressly stated as binding.

Winbuzz may reject or return a request connected to prohibited activity, inaccurate information or an unsupported payment method.

Promotion Rules

Promotions may be offered only where legally permitted.

Users must read the complete conditions, including eligibility, validity period and service restrictions.

A promotional headline does not override the detailed rules.

Creating duplicate accounts, submitting false information or coordinating with other users to misuse a promotion is prohibited.

Communication Rules

Users must communicate honestly and respectfully with Winbuzz support.

Abusive language, threats, deliberate misinformation and repeated spam may lead to communication restrictions.

Support requests should describe one issue clearly and include the relevant account or transaction reference.

Passwords, OTPs and complete financial credentials must not be included.

Evidence Submitted to Support

Screenshots, receipts and documents submitted to support must be genuine and relevant.

Users should hide unrelated private information before uploading evidence.

Edited or fabricated evidence may lead to account review.

Submitting evidence does not guarantee a particular decision. It allows the support team to compare the user’s information with available records.

Reviews and Public Comments

Reviews should describe genuine personal experiences and must not impersonate another person.

Users must not publish another account holder’s private information, payment details or identity documents.

Defamatory, fraudulent, threatening or unlawful submissions may be removed.

No user review should be presented as proof of guaranteed winnings or financial success.

Intellectual Property Rules

The Winbuzz name, original website content, graphics, design, software and other protected materials may not be copied or commercially reused without permission.

Users may view platform content for personal and lawful purposes.

Removing ownership notices or presenting Winbuzz material as another party’s work is prohibited.

Third-party trademarks, data and media remain subject to the rights of their respective owners.

Privacy Rules

Users must respect the privacy of other account holders, support agents and third parties.

No person may collect, publish or misuse another user’s personal information.

Winbuzz processes personal data according to its Privacy Policy and applicable law.

Privacy concerns should be submitted through the verified grievance or privacy contact.

Cookie and Browser Rules

Winbuzz may use cookies and similar technologies for login sessions, preferences, security and website performance.

Users may control optional cookies through available settings.

Blocking essential cookies can affect login or account functions.

Users must not manipulate cookies or session identifiers to gain unauthorised access.

Responsible Gaming Rules

Where a lawful gaming-related feature is available, users should establish time and spending limits before beginning.

Gaming must not be treated as guaranteed income or a solution to debt.

Users must not chase losses, borrow money for gaming or use funds needed for essential expenses.

Users may request a cooling-off period, self-exclusion or account closure through verified support.

Self-Exclusion Rules

A self-excluded user must not create another account, use another person’s Winbuzz ID or attempt to bypass the restriction.

The exclusion should remain in effect for the selected or required period.

Winbuzz should not send promotional communications encouraging a self-excluded user to return to restricted activity.

A request for self-exclusion should be handled as a protection request rather than an ordinary marketing issue.

Protection of Minors

Adults must protect their accounts and devices from access by minors.

Passwords and payment details should not be stored in a way that allows a child to use them.

A person who suspects underage access should report it to Winbuzz.

An underage account may be restricted while age and ownership are reviewed.

Account Review Procedure

Winbuzz may review an account when there is a credible security, eligibility, verification, legal or conduct concern.

The review may consider account information, device records, platform activity and relevant provider data.

Where appropriate, users should receive an explanation of the information required from them.

A review should be completed fairly and should not remain open longer than reasonably necessary.

Temporary Account Restrictions

A temporary restriction may be applied while an account issue is investigated.

The restriction may affect login, profile changes or selected features, depending on the nature of the concern.

Users must not open another account to avoid the restriction.

Where legally permitted, Winbuzz should explain the reason and provide an appropriate response process.

Account Closure

An account may be closed at the user’s request or after a serious violation.

Closure may require identity confirmation and completion of any lawful outstanding account process.

Some information may remain subject to legal, privacy, security or dispute-related retention requirements.

Closing an account does not remove obligations arising from earlier unlawful or fraudulent activity.

Enforcement of These Rules

Winbuzz may respond to a violation with a warning, feature restriction, temporary suspension, account review or closure.

The response should be proportionate to the seriousness, evidence and potential harm involved.

Certain activity may be referred to an authorised provider or public authority where required by law.

Enforcement does not remove a user’s applicable complaint or statutory rights.

Appeals and Complaints

Users may challenge an account or platform decision through the verified complaint process.

The complaint should include the Winbuzz ID, original case reference, date and a clear explanation.

New evidence should be submitted honestly and in an unedited form.

Winbuzz should provide an appropriate review and explain the decision where legally and operationally possible.

Changes to These Rules

Winbuzz may update these Rules and Regulations when services, technology, security procedures or laws change.

The latest version should display an updated effective date.

Material changes should be communicated appropriately where required.

Users who do not accept updated rules should stop using the affected service and contact support about available account options.

No Waiver of Legal Rights

These Rules do not remove rights that users hold under applicable consumer, privacy or other law.

A failure by Winbuzz to enforce a rule immediately does not permanently waive that rule.

No informal message should override the published regulations unless an authorised representative confirms the change.

Any invalid rule should be limited or corrected only to the extent necessary to make it lawful.

Final Rules Statement

Every Winbuzz user is expected to act lawfully, provide accurate information, protect account credentials and respect platform restrictions.

No provision permits access to a prohibited service. No user may use Winbuzz to bypass age requirements, geographical restrictions, account controls or legal obligations.

These Rules and Regulations should be reviewed before registration and whenever a material update is announced.

Frequently Asked Questions About Winbuzz Rules and Regulations

1. Why must users follow the Winbuzz Rules and Regulations?

The rules establish standards for lawful access, account security, accurate registration, fair platform use and responsible behaviour. Following them helps protect users, platform records and available services. A serious or repeated violation may lead to account review, restriction or closure.

2. Who is allowed to create a Winbuzz account?

Only adults who meet the applicable legal age, location and eligibility requirements may register. Users must provide their own accurate information and should not create an account for another person. Registration does not guarantee access to every feature.

3. Can I use more than one Winbuzz ID?

Users should maintain only the number of accounts permitted by the platform rules. Duplicate accounts must not be created to avoid verification, self-exclusion, service restrictions or promotional conditions. Contact support if you cannot access an existing account.

4. What happens if I provide incorrect registration information?

An account may be restricted when important details are false, incomplete or inconsistent. Winbuzz may request verification before restoring access or changing protected information. Users should correct genuine mistakes through the account settings or verified support process.

5. Can I access Winbuzz from a location where gaming is restricted?

Users must not access a service that is prohibited in their current location. They must not provide a false address, hide their location or use technical tools to bypass a regional restriction. Feature availability may change according to applicable legal requirements.

6. What activities are prohibited on Winbuzz?

Prohibited conduct may include account sharing, identity misuse, duplicate registration, fraudulent documents, unauthorised automated access, security interference, result manipulation and unlawful payments. Winbuzz must also not be used for any online money gaming activity prohibited by applicable law.

7. Can I transfer my Winbuzz account to another person?

A Winbuzz account should remain under the control of its registered owner. It must not be sold, rented, transferred or shared. Users are responsible for protecting their login details and reporting any unfamiliar access through verified support.

8. What should I do if I notice a technical error?

Stop using the affected feature and report the issue through the verified Contact Us section. Include the date, time, device, page and error message. Do not deliberately exploit the problem, alter records or repeatedly perform an action that may create incorrect results.

9. Why can Winbuzz temporarily restrict an account?

A temporary restriction may be applied when eligibility, account ownership, verification, security, prohibited conduct or legal compliance requires review. Users should follow the instructions provided and avoid opening another account while the review is active.

10. How can I challenge a Winbuzz account decision?

Submit a complaint through the verified grievance or support channel. Include your Winbuzz ID, original case reference, relevant date and a clear explanation. Provide genuine supporting evidence without sharing your password, OTP, UPI PIN or banking credentials.
